$comment: Curated Google Fonts shortlist, split by the job each face does. Six per role, not the full ~1800-family directory: an agency picking a brand face wants a considered set, not a search box. Each list is deliberately flat — WordPress's SelectControl renders plain options with no optgroup support, so a nested structure silently collapses to its group labels. Families are downloaded and self-hosted on save; nothing is ever requested from Google at page-render time. Add a family by name only — available weights are discovered from the API at install.
